Definition: Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Benaiah means "Jehovah has built." The name belongs to twelve Israelites, the best known being Benaiah son of Jehoiada, one of David's mighty men. It turns up in 2 Samuel 8:18, 2 Samuel 20:23, 2 Samuel 23:20 and 2 Samuel 23:22.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Benaiah is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
